cat > /app/fix2.R << 'FIXEOF'
txt <- paste(readLines("/app/ars.R", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
rep <- function(s, old, new) {
  if (!grepl(old, s, fixed = TRUE)) stop("PATTERN NOT FOUND: ", substr(old, 1, 60))
  sub(old, new, s, fixed = TRUE)
}
# 1) tail sampling sign: x = x0 + log(1-u)/d  (was x0 - log(1-u)/d)
txt <- rep(txt,
  "    return(x0 - log1p(-u) / d)          # L = -Inf needs d > 0; R = +Inf needs d < 0",
  "    return(x0 + log1p(-u) / d)          # L = -Inf needs d > 0; R = +Inf needs d < 0")
# 2) correct interleaved breakpoints (x1, z1, x2, z2, ..., xm)
txt <- rep(txt,
  "  vec <- as.vector(rbind(x[-m], z, x[-1]))",
  "  vec <- c(x[1L], as.vector(rbind(z, x[-1L])))")
writeLines(strsplit(txt, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]], "/app/ars.R")
cat("FIXES 1+2 APPLIED\n")
FIXEOF
Rscript /app/fix2.R && Rscript /app/ars.R 2>&1 | tail -28
